title: session history
content:
# Save, sync, and query session history Keep a copy of an agent conversation, find earlier work, or share results with collaborators. Export or copy a conversation for a standalone record, or use session-history tracking and sync to search across your work. {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} maintains a searchable history of your {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness sessions. Session sync (Experimental) can upload local session history to your GitHub account for cross-device access and sharing. With sync enabled, you can query work from {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cli_short %}, code review, and the {% data variables.copilot.github_copilot_app %}. Synced sessions are private unless you explicitly share them. To resume a task rather than search its history, see [Find and resume a session](/docs/agents/run/sessions/manage-sessions.md#find-and-resume-a-session).
Launch a chat prompt that summarizes your recent coding sessions into a standup report. * [Open in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}](vscode://GitHub.Copilot-Chat/chat?agent=agent%26prompt=%2Fchronicle%3Astandup)
